data.gender_notes: Jagmohini is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jagmohini is a Hindu goddess name, derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Victorious Goddess'. The name Jagmohini carries the meaning “Goddess of Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jagmohini usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizing triumph over challenges, Jagmohini embodies inner strength and wisdom.
data.etymology: Jagmohini belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jagmohini total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: Jagmohini is an embodiment of the power and victory of the divine feminine in Hinduism. She is often depicted holding weapons, symbolizing her power to protect and destroy evil. Jagmohini is also associated with the Navadurga, a group of nine forms of goddess Durga, and is celebrated during the Navratri festival, where she is invoked and worshipped as a symbol of fearlessness and strength.
data.spiritual_significance: Jagmohini represents the divine mother, who bestows victories in all aspects of life, including spiritual growth and material success. She inspires bravery and fearlessness, empowering us to face our fears and overcome obstacles. Jagmohini's name itself is a reminder of the ultimate triumph of the divine, invoking faith and devotion in those who call upon her.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Jagmohini is a name of the divine mother, symbolizing the eternal dance of creation and destruction in the universe. Her name means 'the enchantress who leads the cosmic dance'.
